notes: Encoded from Mini-Star's own page only. Page states year only; no month rule is stated in text, so the style ships year-only. Page images are serial-number and data-plate photos, no chart table.

styles.notes: Page: year = 1st & 2nd numerical digits (1-based, converted to [0,2]). Leading digits, so character and digit-only counting coincide. Example as printed with dashes; dashes strip under normalization.
